text: S647 found GetonAgain Garment CAD V2024.1 to be a credible apparel DXF/AAMA candidate based on its manual and vendor catalog, but not eligible for a fixture test yet: official sources do not establish trial rights for this product-development evaluation or local-only handling, and its site advertises cloud conversion for other formats. No installer/account/vendor contact/fixture import occurred. V03 remains In Progress with all gates/holds unchanged. See E-G04-S647-EXIT.
